values.note: Three-tiered campground, mostly tent sites. Eight sites take a 23-ft rig: site 2 (50 ft pull-through), sites 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 and 24 (34 ft pull-through) and site 11 (34 ft back-in); the rest are 15-22 ft or tent-only. Also 3 yurts.

sites.source: https://massdcrcamping.reserveamerica.com/camping/october-mountain-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MA&parkId=32615 ('October Mountain campground includes 44 campsites and three yurts with a three-tiered layout'; site list: 23 TENT ONLY, 10 POPUP/TENT, 8 RV/TRAILER NON ELECTRIC, 1 STANDARD NON ELECTRIC, 3 YURT; Equip length 50 ft pull-through on site 002, 34 ft on 7 sites, 15-22 ft on the rest), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://massdcrcamping.reserveamerica.com/camping/october-mountain-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MA&parkId=32615 ('RESERVATIONS REQUIRED. NO WALK-IN CAMPING ALLOWED.', 'Advance Reservations can be made same day up until 2 pm on date of arrival'), read 2026-10-28

note: MA DCR campground in Lee at the edge of October Mountain, the largest state forest in Massachusetts (17,000 acres; Schermerhorn Gorge trail), handy to Tanglewood. Black bears visit: food lockers at every site. An electric power station across the road from the entrance gives a low hum. The forest has ATV/OHM trails (ATVs must be trailered in the campground). --Claude
